bioconda.name: ldsc-rs
bioconda.summary: Fast Rust reimplementation of LD Score Regression (LDSC)
bioconda.description:
ldsc-rs is a compiled Rust reimplementation of Bulik-Sullivan et al.'s
LD Score Regression (LDSC): SNP heritability (h2), genetic correlation
(rg), LD score computation (l2), summary-statistics munging and
annotation building. The installed binary is named `ldsc` and also
accepts the original Python LDSC flag syntax (--h2, --rg, --l2).
